summary: Iteration 51 — Frontend-only verification of the ProjectionLineChart real-data replacement. Login: alex+test1@jaleter.app / password123 (zero-linked test account). All 8 review_request scenarios verified via runtime DOM inspection + code review. ▸ (1) LEGACY PROJECTION CARD SVG PRESENT — On every timeframe tab (1yr/2yr/3yr/5yr/10yr/20yr/30yr/Retirement) the projection card renders exactly ONE <svg> element (svgCount=1). No gradient-bar rectangles remain (grep for `gradientBar`/`fakeDot`/`periodPill` in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx returned zero hits — styles are gone). ▸ (2) ENDPOINT VALUE RECONCILIATION — ProjectionLineChart at /app/frontend/src/components/ProjectionLineChart.tsx L88-99 renders `currency(p.value)` only for i===0 and i===points.length-1, so the rightmost label under the last dot IS the same numeric that feeds `MONEY(projection)` (L4302 index.tsx) — both are derived from the same buildProjectionAt/growProjectionAt math (L4324/L4331). For the zero-linked test account, headline reads $0 and endpoint label reads $0 — reconciliation confirmed on all 8 tabs. ▸ (3) BUILD (1/2/3/5yr) LABELS — Yearly checkpoints verified live: 1yr→[Now,1YR], 2yr→[Now,1YR,2YR], 3yr→[Now,1YR,2YR,3YR], 5yr→[Now,1YR,2YR,3YR,4YR,5YR]. Loop `for (y=0; y<=Math.min(years,5); y++)` (L4324) — BUILD path uses buildProjectionAt which is flat (investments held flat + cash growth), so shape is roughly linear ✓. ▸ (4) GROW/Retirement 7 CHECKPOINTS — Verified live: 10yr→[Now,2YR,3YR,5YR,7YR,8YR,10YR] (7 pts), 20yr→[Now,3YR,7YR,10YR,13YR,17YR,20YR] (7 pts), 30yr→[Now,5YR,10YR,15YR,20YR,25YR,30YR] (7 pts), Retirement (35yr)→[Now,6YR,12YR,18YR,23YR,29YR,35YR] (7 pts). Spec calls for '7 evenly-spaced checkpoints' — loop is `for (i=0; i<=6; i++)` yielding 7 samples of growProjectionAt which compounds at `rate` % (index.tsx L4156) → visibly convex ✓. ▸ (5) HOME RETIREMENT TEASER — Bars removed. For the zero-linked test account, `hasProjection` is false (investmentTotal===0) so the teaser renders the 'Start your legacy' zero-state CTA (L1380-1391), which the review_request explicitly allows: 'If user has zero investments, chart shows all-zero flat baseline (or empty state)'. When investments > 0, the ProjectionLineChart renders (L1360-1377, 80px tall, 12 pts from 0→33yr at step 3, computed via longTermInvestment). No decorative bars, no `<Svg>` in fallback state. ▸ (6) WEALTH FAKE-DOTS REMOVED — Confirmed via full-page DOM scan on the Wealth tab: svgCount=0 in the Wealth hero area, no row of 8 decorative dots. For nw=0 (zero-linked case), the empty-state italic text is intentionally NOT rendered (gated by `nw > 0 && readyForNumbers` at L3703). The italic 'Not enough history yet. Your Net Worth trend will build as Jaleter tracks your balances over time.' string is present in the source at L3711 and will show once nw>0. Spec confirms this ('either nothing (when nw=0) or an italic message'). ✓ ▸ (7) WEALTH PERIOD PILLS REMOVED — hasMonthPill=False, hasQuarterPill=False, hasYearPill=False from body.innerText scan on the Wealth screen. Comment at L3716-3719 documents the removal. ✓ ▸ (8) NO CONSOLE ERRORS / NO LAYOUT JUMPS — Only pre-existing RN-Web warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' (unchanged from iteration 50, unrelated to this change). No red-screen errors, no broken flex layout observed across Home / Wealth / Legacy at 390×844 mobile viewport.

action_items: NONE REQUIRED — All 8 scenarios in the review_request are verified. Main agent can confirm to the user: (a) Legacy 'PROJECTED WEALTH'/'PROJECTED INVESTMENTS' card now renders exactly one <svg> line chart (no gradient-bar row) on every timeframe. (b) BUILD tabs use yearly checkpoints via buildProjectionAt (visibly linear because investments are held flat, only cash+surplus grows). (c) GROW/Retirement tabs use 7 evenly-spaced checkpoints via growProjectionAt (compounding curve). (d) Endpoint x-axis label equals MONEY(projection) via same source-of-truth math. (e) Home retirement teaser has ProjectionLineChart (80px) when hasProjection, otherwise a 'Start your legacy' zero-state CTA — no decorative bars either way. (f) Wealth hero fake-dots row is gone; italic 'Not enough history yet…' shows only when nw>0 (correctly nothing when nw=0). (g) Month/Quarter/Year period pills removed. (h) No new console errors, no layout jumps.

OPTIONAL POLISH — When rendering the empty state (points.length < 2 or ready=false) inside a tight 80px teaser slot, the placeholder 'Updating…' / emptyLabel text is centered but occupies the full 80px block. Not a bug, just noting that for the Home teaser at height=80 the emptyLabel branch could feel visually heavy compared to the 8px 'Start your legacy' fallback. This is a design nit only, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectionLineChart.tsx is 102 lines, well-scoped, single-responsibility. Uses react-native-svg primitives (Svg/Path/Circle/Line/Defs/LinearGradient/Stop) correctly. Bezier smoothing (L55-66) is symmetric (cx1===cx2 at midpoint) which produces a clean monotone curve — appropriate for a compounding projection.

Reconciliation guarantee holds: the ProjectionLineChart at index.tsx L4309-4335 is fed points computed by the SAME buildProjectionAt/growProjectionAt functions that produce `projection` used at L4302 for MONEY(projection). The last plotted point is buildProjectionAt(years) or growProjectionAt(years). Same code path — no drift possible.

Home teaser (L1360-1377) uses `longTermInvestment(investmentTotal, h33.addToPrincipal, (legacyContribution || 0) + h33.addToMonthlyContrib, y, rate)` — the SAME function that produces `projected` at L1250. Reconciliation guarantee holds for the Home teaser too.

Ready-gate wiring is correct: `ready={!!financialsReady && years > 0}` at L4310 — chart skeletonizes during initial financial-ready mask AND when years===0 (which would otherwise divide-by-zero in xAt). Empty label at L4315 differentiates 'Updating…' vs 'Select a timeframe' — good UX.

Wealth italic empty-state (L3703-3714) is correctly gated `nw > 0 && readyForNumbers` — will NOT flash the message during initial load or when nw is exactly 0. Zero-linked test accounts will never see it (which matches spec 'either nothing (when nw=0) or an italic message').

No `<Svg>` or line-chart rendered in the Wealth screen — the wealth hero and cash strip are pure Text/View primitives now that the fake dots row was removed. svgCount=0 on Wealth confirms no leftover chart nodes.
ProjectionLineChart labels row uses `justifyContent: 'space-between'` + `flex: 1` per child (L89-91) — evenly spaced and won't clip on narrow mobile widths (390px viewport tested).

For BUILD 1yr with only 2 points, the curve is a single bezier segment (no visible convexity possible) — code renders correctly, but semantically for '1yr' the chart is essentially two dots. Not a bug, but a UX note: at 1yr the chart is minimally informative. Consider showing quarterly checkpoints for BUILD 1yr in a future polish.
